verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents token streaming or real-time delivery of tool-call and step events to a UI. Lifecycle callbacks (google-adk-docs-28) are a developer building block for logging and monitoring, not a documented streaming-output capability, and the built-in dev UI is a testing tool, not a streaming API for the developer's own UI. Streaming is a fair axis for an agent framework, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time
